beats.said: Every day, people type things into AI tools, they wouldn't broadcast publicly at work. Medical questions, money worries.

beats.what: 여성 출연자가 계속 설명. 화면이 클로즈업됨.
beats.said: You should be able to see and control why your AI provider retains about you. You can think of them as four different uses.

beats.what: 애니메이션 화면으로 전환. 챗봇 대화창을 보여주며 'What shall we think through? How can I help you today?' 글자와 'The conversation' 자막이 뜬다.
beats.said: The first use is just for this conversation. It only knows what you choose to put in front of it.

beats.what: 애니메이션 화면. 'your account'와 'product model'이 연결되는 그림. 'Product memory' 자막.
beats.said: The second use is product memory. Many AI tools can now save useful details from one chat to the next.

beats.what: 애니메이션 화면. 'The provider' 자막.
beats.said: The third use is the provider's own systems.

beats.what: 여성 출연자가 다시 화면에 나타나 설명. 클로즈업 상태.
beats.said: Close the chat and it's kept on the provider's timeline under the provider's policy.

beats.what: 애니메이션 화면. 'Training future models' 자막. 대화 내용이 물결 모양으로 표시되다가 일반화된 녹색 블록으로 변하는 모습.
beats.said: The fourth use is training future models. Your conversations aren't stored in the model to be read back to other users. Where providers train future models on conversations, many let you opt out.

beats.what: 여성 출연자가 다시 화면에 나타나 결론을 말한다. 전체적인 실내 배경이 보인다.
beats.said: A few minutes, plus a little thought about what you share, gets you most of the way to using these tools comfortably.
